data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe is the best all-round payment processor**\. However, if you're using Shopify, I'd generally recommend **Shopify Payments** instead.

The best choice depends on your ecommerce platform, where your customers are located, and how much you sell.

If you're operating in Australia, these are the options I'd shortlist.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian store

![Stripe Conversion Tracking – Able Customer Data Platform](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLblf37t9qmSgXH90IIrfyM1cEVlAyfeKTR0KIuJzNcMC_B2ZUJW9p7BftOV-yzXikVmn2jDYU_Zq1ExkRO0GTjHIMaYqcU4RzMNo1YrpDxk3GXGSNzey-FFdr644M2DVq4UsY3Zo9OE1wDfp2BQqWf9beRf_8lKhubJp-AjxGHf8Zwil7Ew0fyQc0BJ2PlA?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Domestic cards: 1.7% + A\$0.30
- International cards: 3.5% + A\$0.30
- No monthly fee
- Excellent integrations, fraud protection and reporting.

Best for WooCommerce, custom websites and independent online stores. [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Supports cards and digital wallets.
- No separate payment gateway subscription.
- Simplifies reconciliation and checkout.

Best if your store is built on Shopify. [www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/credit-card-processing-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Airwallex**

(Best for international sales)

- Domestic cards: 1.65% + A\$0.30.
- International cards: approximately 3.4–3.45% + A\$0.30.
- Multi-currency accounts.
- Useful for businesses selling overseas.

[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/compare-payment-systems-for-small-businesses?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/payment-gateway-providers-services?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers.
- Supports PayPal checkout and card payments.
- Useful as an additional payment option.
- Generally higher fees than some alternatives.

[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/online-payment-services-systems?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/au/blog/best-small-business-payment-gateway-australia?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[PayPal Business Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Square**

- Online processing: 2.2%.
- In-person processing: 1.6%.
- Simple pricing.
- Excellent if you also sell at markets, pop-ups or physical stores.

[squareup.com](https://squareup.com/au/en/payments/our-fees?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

*Fees are published Australian rates as checked in November 2026 where available. Confirm eligibility, GST treatment and any platform-specific charges before signing up.*

## My recommendation

For a new small online store, I'd generally choose\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments, with PayPal as an additional checkout option.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe, with PayPal as an additional option.
- **International customers\:** Consider Airwallex alongside Stripe.

## Let me narrow it down to the best option for your business

There are three things that would help me make a more precise recommendation.

**1\. What platform is your online store using?**
